whenToUse: Appointment, pickup and delivery slots kept on minute steps inside opening hours
Recurring times of day in settings, such as a daily digest, a standup or a shift start
Meeting start and end times, and a publish time set beside a chosen day

whenNotToUse.when: A booking card with a day, a list of open slots, a duration and a confirm step
A day or a range of days picked with no time of day
A whole data entry page where the time is one field among many

agentNotes: A `value` or `defaultValue` set in code shows as given, never snapped to the steps, `min` or `max`; only picks, typing and Now snap
On `TimePickerTrigger`, `aria-label` replaces the shown value in the accessible name; point `aria-labelledby` at a visible label
Inside a right to left `dir` wrapper, pass `dir` to `TimePickerContent` too, because the popover portals out of the wrapper
